nodes.Name: stackWorkBuf
nodes.DocComment:
Buffer for pointers found during stack tracing.
Must be smaller than or equal to workbuf.

nodes.Name: stackWorkBufHdr
nodes.DocComment: Header declaration must come after the buf declaration above, because of issue #14620.

nodes.Name: stackObjectBuf
nodes.DocComment:
Buffer for stack objects found on a goroutine stack.
Must be smaller than or equal to workbuf.

nodes.Name: stackObject
nodes.DocComment:
A stackObject represents a variable on the stack that has had
its address taken.

Fields.Name: r
Fields.DocComment: info of the object (for ptr/nonptr bits). nil if object has been scanned.

nodes.Name: setRecord
nodes.DocComment:
obj.r = r, but with no write barrier.

go:nowritebarrier

nodes.Name: stackScanState
nodes.DocComment:
A stackScanState keeps track of the state used during the GC walk
of a goroutine.

Fields.Name: freeBuf
Fields.DocComment: keep around one free buffer for allocation hysteresis

nodes.Name: putPtr
nodes.DocComment:
Add p as a potential pointer to a stack object.
p must be a stack address.

nodes.Name: getPtr
nodes.DocComment:
Remove and return a potential pointer to a stack object.
Returns 0 if there are no more pointers available.

This prefers non-conservative pointers so we scan stack objects
precisely if there are any non-conservative pointers to them.

nodes.Name: addObject
nodes.DocComment: addObject adds a stack object at addr of type typ to the set of stack objects.

nodes.Name: buildIndex
nodes.DocComment:
buildIndex initializes s.root to a binary search tree.
It should be called after all addObject calls but before
any call of findObject.

nodes.Name: binarySearchTree
nodes.DocComment:
Build a binary search tree with the n objects in the list
x.obj[idx], x.obj[idx+1], ..., x.next.obj[0], ...
Returns the root of that tree, and the buf+idx of the nth object after x.obj[idx].
(The first object that was not included in the binary search tree.)
If n == 0, returns nil, x.

nodes.Name: findObject
nodes.DocComment:
findObject returns the stack object containing address a, if any.
Must have called buildIndex previously.
